proposals.before: Gao Huan memorialized to trim state enfeoffments and reward civil and military officials; Zuan received the usual grant and was enfeoffed marquis of Shouzhang.
proposals.after: Gao Huan memorialized to trim state enfeoffments and reward civil and military officials; Zuan received the usual grant and was enfeoffed baron of Shouzhang.
proposals.reason: Chinese 壽張伯 is baron/earl (伯), not marquis (侯).

proposals.before: He was sent out as inspector of West Yan Province, where he investigated and enforced prohibitions. After more than a year he was dismissed when the charges could not be proved.
proposals.after: He was sent out as inspector of West Yan Province, where he investigated and enforced prohibitions. After more than a year he was cleared when the charges could not be proved.
proposals.reason: 獲免 means he obtained exoneration/release, not dismissal from office.

proposals.before: In the first year of Heqing he was summoned and appointed minister of the imperial clan.
proposals.after: In the first year of Heqing he was summoned and appointed minister of sacrificial worships.
proposals.reason: 祠部尚書 is the board of sacrifices/rites, not the imperial clan office (宗正).

proposals.before: In Xinghe Zhong, Gao Cheng summoned him as vault attendant and made him court gentleman attendant.
proposals.after: During Xinghe, Gao Cheng summoned him as vault attendant and made him court gentleman attendant.
proposals.reason: 興和中 means during the Xinghe era, not a place or name 'Xinghe Zhong'.

proposals.before: When Shizong died, he barred the gate — to the end, bright in faith and obedience.
proposals.after: By the tree-death and the barred gate — to the end, bright in faith and obedience.
proposals.reason: 樹死拒關 pairs Erzhu Zhao's hanging from a tree with Zhang Yao's refusing the gate; it does not mention Shizong.

decisions.reason: s0009 has 封壽張伯; 伯 is the baron/earl rank, not marquis (侯), so “baron of Shouzhang” correctly matches the Chinese title.
s0100’s 以無驗獲免 means he obtained clearance when nothing was proven; “dismissed” wrongly suggests removal from office, while “cleared” matches the Chinese.
s0144 has 祠部尚書, the board of sacrificial worships/rites, not the imperial-clan office (宗正); “minister of sacrificial worships” restores the correct office.
s0185’s 興和中 is the conventional “during Xinghe”; treating 中 as part of a name “Xinghe Zhong” invents a place/person the Chinese does not support.

decisions.after: Tree-death and barred gate — to the end, bright in faith and obedience.
decisions.reason: s0218 is only 樹死拒關，終明信順 and never names Shizong; the proposal rightly removes that invention, but “By the tree-death” is awkward, so the revision keeps the terse allusive pair.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 restores baron for 伯; the English title claim’s “Marquis” came only from the bad idiomatic and must change while keeping id, subject, predicate, zh, certainty, and evidence.
